description: This Java class defines a SOAP client engine for invoking remote SOAP services within the OFBiz framework. It manages service invocation, parameter serialization, and response deserialization.

classes.name: SOAPClientEngine
classes.description: A final class extending GenericAsyncEngine that provides methods to invoke SOAP services synchronously, handling parameter serialization and response processing.

methods.name: SOAPClientEngine
methods.description: Constructor initializing the engine with a ServiceDispatcher.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Overrides to invoke runSync and ignore the result.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes the SOAP service call synchronously and returns the result map.

methods.name: serviceInvoker
methods.description: Handles the core logic of setting up the SOAP client, serializing parameters, sending the request, and processing the response.
